ADVERT.gloss: a public promotion of some product or service
ADVERT.definition: A public promotion of some product or service.

TRADE.gloss: the commercial exchange of goods and services
TRADE.definition: The commercial exchange (buying and selling on domestic or international markets) of goods and services.
TRADE.example: Venice was an important center of trade with the East.

TREAD.gloss: put down or press the foot, place the foot
TREAD.definition: Put down or press the foot, place the foot.
TREAD.example: For fools rush in where angels fear to tread.

AVERT.definition: Prevent the occurrence of; prevent from happening.

READ.gloss: interpret something that is written or printed
READ.definition: Interpret something that is written or printed.

DATE.gloss: the specified day of the month
DATE.definition: The specified day of the month.

RATE.gloss: a magnitude or frequency relative to a time unit
RATE.definition: A magnitude or frequency relative to a time unit.
RATE.example: They traveled at a rate of 55 miles per hour.

ARE.gloss: a unit of surface area equal to 100 square meters
ARE.definition: A unit of surface area equal to 100 square meters.

RED.definition: Red color or pigment; the chromatic color resembling the hue of blood.

ART.definition: The products of human creativity; works of art collectively.

TEA.gloss: a beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water
TEA.definition: A beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water.
TEA.example: Iced tea is a cooling drink.

ERA.gloss: a period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event
ERA.definition: A period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event.

EAR.gloss: the sense organ for hearing and equilibrium
EAR.definition: The sense organ for hearing and equilibrium.

TEAR.gloss: separate or cause to separate abruptly
TEAR.definition: Separate or cause to separate abruptly.

DARE.definition: Take upon oneself; act presumptuously, without permission.
DARE.example: How dare you call my lawyer?
